name: Proxima Protocol
source:
500 fathoms deep in the Arctic Ocean a strange ice-like structure has been discovered.

Captain V. Chimel has been selected for the research operation.

[Missing entry]

Currently, only 4 members remain on the vessel, while the rest have been moved to the above-water site.
